candidates.title: Haunted Hacks: Real-Time AI Edition
candidates.evidence:
Hosted By
Y Combinator
Haunted Hacks
Saturday, October 31
San Francisco, CA
Capacity 225
About Event
Come join us for Haunted Hacks to kick off Halloween this year. Hosted by[ Terse](https://www.useterse.ai/) (F26) and[ AgentRelay](https://agentrelay.com/) (F26), brought to you by OpenAI, Supabase (S20), Mastra (W25),  Freestyle (F24) and Superserve (F26).

Every participant will receive:

\- $100 in OpenAI API credits per participant.

- $25 in Supabase credits per each attendee (equivalent to 1 free month of Pro plan)

- $100 in [Freestyle](https://www.freestyle.sh/) credits per each attendee

- $100 in [Superserve.ai](http://Superserve.ai)[ ](http://superserve.ai)credits per attendee


Love Durable Objects? Come build with our Open Source alternative!

Tired of copy/pasting messages between your agents? Come see how much you can build when you let agents collaborate directly with Agent Relay!

Want to do both at the same time? Even better!

Lunch, snacks, candy, bad Halloween/AI puns, swag, coffee, and prizes are all included.

Tracks include:

 Hackathon winner: A guaranteed YC interview
 Stateful Apps: Build with [Durable Actors](https://docs.useterse.ai/quickstart) from Terse - iPhone Duo
 Agent to agent communication built with Agent Relay: Mac Mini
 Costume contest: Bragging rights

### October 31, 2026 · San Francisco, CA

### Eligibility

We recommend working in groups, and we're happy to help you form a team if you're coming on your own.

This is an in-person event in San Francisco. You must be able to attend on-site to participate.

Attendees must be 16 or older.

### Schedule

 10:00am - 11:00am: Doors Open + Registration
 11:00am: Hacking begins
 1:00pm: Lunch
 4:00pm: Submission deadline
 4:00pm - 5:00pm: Judging
 5:00pm - 6:00pm: Award Ceremony


What to build

The Actor world is hot right now. Come build your own Software Factory, long-running agent, multiplayer AI system or something super creative you've been itching to try out.

### Projects should ideally use either Durable actors, or Agent Relay (bonus points if you use both at the same time).\


Rules

All code must be created at the hackathon.

Thinking of ideas before the hackathon is fine.

### Judging


We will be using [Builderbase](https://builderbase.com/) to manage the judging! Participant signup will occur on check-in. 

The top entries will demo live at the end of the event, and judges will select winners from those demos.

Judges are looking for either very well-executed products or incredibly creative use cases using Durable Actors and Agent Relay. Again, bonus points if you can do both!

Judges will be announced soon.

### Prizes

The best overall project will receive a guaranteed YC Interview, $5k in OpenAI API credits, $10,000 in Freestyle credits, $1000 in [Superserve.ai](http://Superserve.ai) credits and 3 months free of Mastra Platform.

The second place team will receive $2.5k in OpenAI API Credits and 2 months free of Mastra Platform.

The third place team will receive $1k in OpenAI API Credits and 1 month free of Mastra Platform.


The best project using Durable Actors will get an iPhone duo. 

The best project built using Agent Relay will get a Mac mini.

The project deemed the “most likely to scale to millions” will receive $1K in credits from Supabase


More prizes will be announced!

### Don’t Know What Actors/Durable Objects Are?

Here are some great resources:

 <https://docs.useterse.ai/quickstart>
 <https://boristane.com/blog/what-are-cloudflare-durable-objects/>
 <https://x.com/aboodman/status/2088155104851657110>

candidates.title: Naïve Autonomous Company Hackathon: Build an agent-run company that runs itself
candidates.evidence:
Hosted By
Y Combinator
Naïve Autonomous Company Hackathon
Saturday, November 7
San Francisco, CA
Capacity 200
About Event
A two-day hackathon for builders who want to start a company run by agents.

Join Naïve at the YC office in San Francisco. Choose a business, build its team with the Naïve SDK, and put it to work: finding customers, delivering the product, and running day-to-day operations.

At demo time, show the company operating. Not just what it could do, but what its agents actually accomplished. What did they deliver? What decisions did they make? Where did you need to step in?

Applications are reviewed by Naïve and YC, and attendance is subject to approval.

### About Naïve

Naïve is building autonomous companies: agent systems that can run real businesses end to end.

Use the Naïve SDK to create the agents that run your company, connect their tools, set their budgets, and keep their work running. Our studio lets you deploy and operate these systems.

We've raised a $28.5M Series A from Nexus Venture Partners, Y Combinator, Zetta Venture Partners, Liquid 2, and leading operators.

### What You Can Build

Build any company that is primarily run by agents. The industry and business model are up to you.

All teams must use the Naïve SDK to build their company. SDK documentation: [usenaive.ai/docs](https://usenaive.ai/docs)

A few examples (not required tracks):

 Media companies: Agents decide what to publish, produce the content, and use audience results to plan what comes next.
 Agencies: Agents find prospects, scope projects, deliver client work, and manage follow-up.
 Commerce businesses: Agents choose what to sell, run campaigns, handle customer requests, and adjust based on sales.
 Software businesses: Agents build a product, bring in users, handle support, and decide what to improve from customer feedback.

### Prizes

We'll recognize 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place overall, plus winners in these categories:

 Most Autonomous Company
 Most Likely to Become a Unicorn
 Best Use of Naïve
 People's Choice

Prizes
\- iPhone 18 Pros for every team member AND a guaranteed YC interview for 1st place

\- $50,000+ in sponsor credits for 1st place

\- Mac Mini Pros for every team member (2nd place)

\- Mac Minis for every team member (3rd place)

\- Additional prize tracks ($15k+ in prizes): Most likely to scale to millions, People’s Choice, Best Design  

\- All participants get $1k+ in Naive and sponsor credits

### Schedule

Nov 7, 2026

11:00 AM: Doors open

11:30 AM: Welcome Note

12:00 PM: Lunch served

1:00 PM: Hacking begins

6:30 PM: Dinner served

Nov 8, 2026

9:00 AM: Breakfast served

11:00 AM: Hacking stops, judging begins

12:00 PM: Lunch served

1:00 PM: Final presentations

1:45 PM: Winner Announcement + Prizes

2:30 PM: Event ends

### Judges & Mentors

Coming soon.

### Rules & Logistics

 Plan to attend both days in San Francisco. Come solo, bring a team, or meet teammates at kickoff.
 Apply through this page. Only approved attendees may attend.
 Attendees must be at least 15. Participants aged 15-17 must have YC's parental consent form signed before the event.
 Teams will present live demos. Judges will focus on how much of the company runs without you.
 Meals, snacks, and non-alcoholic drinks will be provided. Bring your laptop and charger.

### Sponsors

Coming soon.

Bring a business idea. Build the team that runs it.
